* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Toreno.png]] [[../Verdant Meadows/]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar School.png]] CJ's airstrip, Verdant Meadows, Bone County
|}

Climb the stairs at the back of the control tower, and enter the red marker to trigger this mission. Toreno phones, and tells you that you have to learn how to fly if you want to continue to help your brother. You now have to get bronze certificates or better in each test of [[File:GTA San Andreas radar School.png]] [[../Flying School/]] to continue with the story. Step in the red marker again to trigger it.

== Rewards ==
* Remaining property in San Andreas available for purchase.
* Planes and helicopters in all airports can now be entered.
* Victim clothing store now open.
